annotations.title: Transfers between the person’s own accounts

description: Lists the transfers between two of the person’s own accounts that imports have found: a row leaving one account and the same amount arriving in another within a few days. Undecided ones by default; `answer` reads the transfers or the rows that are not one. An answered transfer is neither income nor spending. `answer_transfers` answers them.
